svg.aria-label: The truffle CLI: list peers, send a message, copy a file, publish a local server
svg.title: The truffle CLI: list peers, send a message, copy a file, publish a local server
svg.desc: A terminal session. truffle ls lists three online peers. truffle send delivers a message to bob-laptop. truffle cp copies build.zip to bob-laptop and verifies its SHA-256. truffle serve publishes localhost:3000 at an https ts.net address.
